basics.name: Vitaliia Bilaniuk
basics.label: Senior Frontend Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Frontend Engineer with 8+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance web applications using Angular and React. Proven track record of delivering complex, data-heavy products, improving application architecture, and optimizing performance. Experienced in working across multiple frontend codebases in parallel, with a strong focus on clean architecture, reusable components, and code quality. Comfortable in remote environments and actively expanding into fullstack development.

work.summary: As a contractor, worked with Hawaii Information Service company team on their MLS tool
highlights: - Contributed to a production-grade MLS platform used by 1,000+ real estate agents to search, analyze, and manage property listings
- Delivered interactive map-based search using ArcGIS, improving property discovery and reducing search time for users
- Contributed to active development of both Angular and React applications in parallel, delivering features across two production codebases
- Built UI components and implemented feature logic in React using modern patterns (hooks, state management, Redux)
- Reduced technical debt by migrating Angular 14 → 18 within an NX monorepo, improving maintainability and release stability
- Implemented NgRx state management, reducing state-related bugs and improving data consistency across the application
- Built and maintained unit tests (Jasmine/Jest/Karma), increasing code reliability and reducing regressions
- Optimized performance of data-heavy views, improving responsiveness and user experience
- Automated CI/CD workflows with Docker & Jenkins, reducing manual deployment effort and improving release consistency
- Built reusable UI components using PrimeNG, accelerating feature development and ensuring UI consistency
- Integrated and maintained mobile-ready builds using Capacitor, enabling hybrid deployment
- Actively contributed to architectural decisions, code reviews, and performance improvements across the project

work.summary: As a contractor, worked with Clickatell company team on two web-portals (admin and client portal) simultaneously, using Angular 8 and Angular 11.
highlights: - Developed complex, data-driven dashboards on the admin portal using Angular
- Implemented key frontend features on the client portal, including payments (Cybersource 3D Secure), transaction history, account settings, and subscriptions
- Reimplemented legacy functionality using modern frontend patterns and improved component architecture
- Built reusable UI components and applied patterns transferable across Angular and React ecosystems
- Worked with data visualization tools including Power BI integrations and configurable charts
- Collaborated on frontend architecture and code quality improvements across projects using modern JavaScript frameworks (Angular, React)
- Upgraded the application from Angular 8 to Angular 11, reducing technical debt and improving stability
- Onboarded and mentored new team members, sharing best practices and improving code quality

highlights: - Created various landing pages using HTML, CSS3, jQuery, Bootstrap
- Adjusted WordPress themes to customer's needs
- Created many static websites using Jekyll and hugo site generators
